brief: Goldman's Sales & Trading download for 18 Sep. CTAs are estimated long $37.54bn of US equities (22nd percentile, 1y), with modeled next-month SPX flows of -$5.4bn if flat, -$54bn if down, +$17bn if up. GIR raises its 2027 hyperscaler gross debt issuance forecast to $420bn (up 60%+ from the 2026 estimate of $250bn), against $229bn issued in 2026 so far and $578bn of global AI-related debt issuance tracked overall. Hyperscalers are still just 40% of that AI-debt total, and AI-related notional runs 12% of USD IG and 6% of USD HY versus 3%/1% in EUR. Equities extended gains as markets digested the prior day's Fed hike: breadth was strong (292 SPX names green), MegaCap Tech (+168bps) led, and Prime Brokerage data shows Mag7 net allocation up to ~20% (95th percentile) from a 14% YTD low. GIR still expects an October hike, a 3.25-3.5% neutral rate, and cuts through March 2028. Oil eased on reports China asked Iran to rein in the Houthis, with a possible Trump Middle East meeting next Tuesday. Single-name notes: Amer Sports raised Salomon's growth targets, INNIO booked a 450MW Texas data-center order (Buy, PT $40), and Autodesk stays Neutral post-AU26.
